label: ციტატა
about: The Witness: the people who speak carry the story, in their own verbatim words.
brief: The film is told by the people quoted in the articles, in their exact words.
First 2 s: the hook says who speaks and about what.
Then the quotes: verbatim, inside „…“, each with its speaker (by) and the outlet (via).
When the articles quote more than one side, show both, one quote scene each.
Between quotes, one scene of context (who they are, or the two sides as a pair).
Never paraphrase inside quote marks; never a quote without a speaker.
The viewer leaves knowing who said what.
pacing: each quote held long enough to read (0.5 s + 0.3 s per word).
